metadata.title: A polynomial formula for the Albanese map of the Cartwright-Steger surface
metadata.abstract: The Albanese fibration of the Cartwright--Steger surface is a genus-$19$ Lefschetz fibration over a torus. We give an explicit formula for it: in the projective model of Borisov and Yeung, the map is represented by three homogeneous polynomials of degree $13$ with integer coefficients, and its target is the elliptic curve $Y^2Z=X^3-3888Z^3$. A recognition theorem shows that it suffices to verify one polynomial identity on the surface. A coefficient bound allows us to establish the identity over $Q$ from computations modulo primes. We also determine exact coordinates for the three nodes and their images on the elliptic curve.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 以三个整系数十三次齐次多项式写出 Cartwright–Steger 曲面的 Albanese 映射，目标是指定椭圆曲线。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出亏格十九 Lefschetz 纤维化的精确公式及三个节点和像的坐标。
analysis.limitations: 有限域计算提升到有理数依赖系数界与识别定理，不是单纯数值拟合。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
